test_dataframe_equality: test two pandas DataFrames for equality ignoring column order using _assert_frame_equal_lazy
test_index_equality: test two pandas Index objects for equality ignoring entry order using _assert_index_equal_lazy
test_tempfile_context: test code that writes to a temporary file using the tempfile_path context manager
test_assert_warns: test that a callable produces warnings using BalanceTestCase assertIfWarns or assertWarnsRegexp
test_assert_prints: test that a callable produces stdout or stderr output using BalanceTestCase assertPrints or assertPrintsRegexp
